candidate.flaw_one_line: Admin page-creation forms accept a client-chosen copy source / existing target page with no object-level view/change check.

verified.exploit_entry_point: HTTP POST through the Django admin test client as a section editor (page-level add/change on one subtree, admin reached via ?parent_page=) or a site-1-only manager: /admin/cms/pagecontent/<id>/duplicate/, /admin/cms/pagecontent/add/, and the page wizard /admin/cms/placeholder/cms_wizard/create/ (two formtools steps). All 9 security tests fail by assertion at the pinned commit (exploit lands: restricted plugin text copied / translation created).
sites: cms/admin/forms.py:514-519 DuplicatePageForm hidden source [published, landing, T1]
cms/admin/forms.py:279-287 cms_page site narrowing skipped by hidden-source early return [published, T2]
cms/admin/forms.py:334-338 no change check on cms_page (add translation) [published, far site T2]
routes: cms/admin/forms.py:248-252 AddPageForm page-type source: queryset all page types, no view check; also reached with cms_page set (translation + source copies into existing page) [uncovered, T3; open on pinned AND on the published fix: published_fix_only.patch fails exactly the T3+T4 tests]
cms/forms/wizards.py:22,67-98 CreateCMSPageForm inherits the source field; its clean() overrides the base clean() without super() [uncovered, T4; confirmed same way]
dropped: cms/admin/forms.py:445-453 AddPageTypeForm: no in-tree caller, and its from_source() calls Page.copy without user, which asserts (cms/models/pagemodel.py:469), so it cannot copy at the pinned commit - not reachable, not a lever

screener shape 'fewer than 2 page types hides source': wrong - the early return checks the widget before it is swapped to hidden, so only the duplicate form skips the narrowing; the cross-site target test therefore drives the duplicate route
